sources.title: Park Fuzz Sound Vintage Germanium Fuzz Tone — EarthQuaker Devices
sources.excerpt: Park Fuzz Sound™ Vintage Germanium Fuzz Tone Park Amplifiers and EarthQuaker Devices have teamed up to bring you a faithful recreation of the original Park Fuzz Sound! While it retains the original sounds, there are several modern upgrades to improve performance, reduce extraneous background noise and add versatility: Metal film resistors and caps for quieter performance NOS matched germanium transistors for consistent, reliable tones Wider fuzz range, more than twice the original Smaller footprint, true bypass switching with LED indication and power supply compatible 1. Treble/Bass: This is the tone control, thicker tones to the right, brighter to the left. 1.
